items.quote: Wir liefern und montieren ihn am Samstag, 12.12.2026; unser Team ist ab 08:00 Uhr bei Ihnen und braucht etwa drei Stunden.
items.computation: The letter states the delivery date explicitly as Saturday 12.12.2026 starting 08:00. A calendar date/appointment printed in the letter is used as written and is never moved by weekend or holiday rules.

items.title: Call to reschedule if the delivery date does not suit
items.quote: Passt Ihnen der Tag nicht, rufen Sie uns spätestens drei Werktage vorher an.
items.computation: Werktage (working days for this private-law deadline) run Monday to Saturday, excluding public holidays. Counting back from the delivery day Saturday 12.12.2026: 1 Werktag before = Friday 11.12.2026; 2 Werktage before = Thursday 10.12.2026; 3 Werktage before = Wednesday 09.12.2026. No public holidays fall in this window in NW, so the call must be made by Wednesday 09.12.2026 at the latest.
